text: The customer may terminate without cause on one day of notice and owes no compensation for committed supplier costs.
rubric: The stated rubric treats short-notice loss of committed costs as substantial exposure.

text: The supplier accepts unlimited liability for every loss arising under this agreement.
rubric: The stated rubric treats unlimited monetary exposure as substantial risk.

text: Each party's total liability is capped at fees paid during the preceding twelve months, except deliberate misconduct.
rubric: The stated rubric treats an explicit reciprocal monetary cap with a misconduct exception as limited exposure.

text: The supplier assigns all intellectual property, including pre-existing platform code, to the customer without a retained license.
rubric: The stated rubric treats loss of background platform rights without a license as substantial exposure.

text: The supplier shall not compete in any market worldwide for ten years.
rubric: The stated rubric treats an unrestricted market and long duration as substantial commercial concern.

text: After a change of control, supplier must give thirty days of notice; customer may terminate while paying outstanding invoices.
rubric: The stated rubric treats a control-triggered termination right with payment protection as a material concern.

text: This agreement is governed by California law.
rubric: The stated rubric scores clarity of the named law as limited concern; jurisdiction suitability remains unassessed.

text: The supplier will indemnify the customer for all third-party claims without a liability cap or control of the defense.
rubric: The stated rubric treats broad claims and no cap or defense control as substantial exposure.

text: Each party will protect confidential information for three years, with exceptions for public information and legally required disclosure.
rubric: The stated rubric treats reciprocal duties, exceptions and a defined duration as limited concern.

text: The supplier must sell exclusively to the customer for one year, with a minimum purchase commitment and termination rights after unmet orders.
rubric: The stated rubric treats exclusivity with purchase and exit protections as a material concern rather than unrestricted exposure.
